name: form
title: Form
description: Small form helpers: submit on change, debounced submit, keyboard submit, and disabling submit until the form is valid.

attributes.name: data-form-action
attributes.element: the form or any field inside it
attributes.description: Wires events to actions, e.g. "change->submit" or "keydown.meta+enter->submit".

attributes.name: data-form-debounce
attributes.description: Delay in milliseconds for debouncedSubmit. Defaults to 300.

attributes.name: data-form-submitter-param
attributes.description: Id of a submit button to submit with, so its name and value are sent.

actions.name: submit
actions.description: Submits the form with requestSubmit(), so validation and submit listeners still run.

actions.name: debouncedSubmit
actions.description: Submits after the input has been idle for data-form-debounce milliseconds.

actions.name: disableSubmitWhenInvalid
actions.description: Disables the submit target while form.checkValidity() is false.

actions.name: select
actions.description: Selects the text of the field that triggered the event.

actions.name: cancel
actions.description: Clicks the cancel target, if there is one.

notes: css-zero's submitToTopTarget (Turbo frames) and preventAttachment (Trix/Lexxy) actions were removed because they only applied to Hotwire.
